title: Learn from real systems
description: Study four production systems, then connect everything you built.

days.title: How WhatsApp delivers messages
days.objective: See ordering, presence, and fan-out at global scale.

days.title: How Netflix streams
days.objective: Follow encoding, edge delivery, and resilience.

days.title: Compare chat designs
days.objective: Set your chat design beside a real one.

days.title: How GitHub collaborates
days.objective: Store, serve, and secure repositories at scale.

days.title: How Uber matches rides
days.objective: Locate, match, and price in real time.

days.title: Recall delivery pipelines
days.objective: Connect notification design with the worker you built.

days.title: Recall money-safe state
days.objective: Connect payment design with exactly-once event handling.

days.title: Recall the cache, end to end
days.objective: Connect your first cache with a distributed design.

days.title: Trace the whole system
days.objective: Follow one request through everything you learned.

days.title: Real systems checkpoint
days.objective: Bring the case studies together and finish the journey.
